annual.label: Average yearly maintenance and repair cost over the first 10 years (CarEdge 10-year total ÷ 10)

maint.every: Every 10,000 miles or 1 year (first at 10,000 miles)
maint.note: Use synthetic oil that meets VW 502.00 or 508.00 as listed for your engine.

maint.every: About every 30,000–50,000 miles; pads checked at each service
maint.note: Replacing the rotors as well adds to the parts cost.

maint.every: About every 40,000–60,000 miles; pads checked at each service
maint.note: The electronic parking brake must be put in service mode with a scan tool.

maint.every: About every 3–6 years; tested every 20,000 miles
maint.note: The new battery must be registered to the car with a scan tool.
The 3.6L VR6 takes six plugs and needs more labor than the 2.0T.

maint.job: Engine coolant drain and refill (VW G13 type)
maint.every: No fixed interval in VW's schedule; level and protection checked every 20,000 miles
maint.note: Use only VW-approved coolant. Watch for water pump leaks on high-mileage cars.
